title: Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe
author: Preston Norton
current_text: Parent Stephanie Krizan petitioned CFAUSD to remove Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe, citing concerns about vulgarities, sexual descriptions and drug use; a review committee decided against banning it or taking other action, but the board voted 5–2 to require parental consent for its use as optional reading in classes.

sources.quote: That process was completed and that review committee made the decision that the book Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe should not be banned nor any action taken.
sources.title: Book will not be part of any curriculum at CFAUSD

sources.quote: Therefore, the board voted 5-2 as follows; “To require that the book, Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe, will not be part of the curriculum in any of our classes as optional reading for students without parental consent.”
sources.title: Book will not be part of any curriculum at CFAUSD

sources.quote: That book is Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe by Preston Norton. Parent Stephanie Krizan, who is petitioning for the book to be removed, said she’s concerned with the book’s use of vulgarities, sexual descriptions, drug use and more.
sources.title: Parent petitions CFAUSD to remove book from district
